findings.reason: The cited evidence confirms simultaneous outages on sites sharing LNK-TUN-01-A and the link's topology, but does not explicitly identify a transport failure on the link as the cause.
ALR-0034 explicitly states the drop in traffic, active users, and availability for the three sites starting at 2026-09-27 15:30.
T4 and T10 both confirm that S-TUN-003, S-TUN-012, and S-TUN-018 depend on LNK-TUN-01-A, which connects to AGG-TUN-01.
ALM-000479, ALM-000480, and ALM-000481 all show critical SITE_DOWN alarms raised at 2026-09-27 15:41 on the three sites.
T3 explicitly reports no changes on the specified nodes and their parents between 2026-09-27 15:00 and 2026-09-27 20:30.
T8 reports no maintenance windows and T9 reports no external events for the specified nodes and region during the incident window.
